# Compiler Intrinsics (`%`)

Intrinsics are compiler-built-in operations prefixed with `%` that lower directly to LLVM target instructions or intrinsics with zero call overhead.

| Rule | Specification | Diagnostic |
|---|---|---|
| **Direct invocation** | Must be called immediately with `(...)` (`%min(a, b)`); bare `%min` is rejected | `E3100` |
| **Strict typing** | No implicit integer/float coercion; multi-argument intrinsics require matching numeric widths | `E3084` |
| **SIMD vector broadcasting** | Homogeneous tuples `(T * N)` act as hardware SIMD vectors; scalar arguments passed alongside `(T * N)` are automatically splatted across all `N` lanes | — |

```{.dva .run}
#use io

low = %min(10, 20)
root = %sqrt(16.0)
bits = %popcount(7)
vec = (10, 20, 30)
clamped = %clamp(vec, 12, 25)
io::out $ (low, root, bits, clamped, %to_str(42))
```

## Numeric and SIMD vector operations

| Intrinsic | Argument Types | Return Type | LLVM Lowering | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `%min(a, b)` | `Int` / `(Int * N)` or `Float` / `(Float * N)` | Same as args | `@llvm.smin` / `@llvm.minnum` | Broadcasts scalar with vector |
| `%max(a, b)` | `Int` / `(Int * N)` or `Float` / `(Float * N)` | Same as args | `@llvm.smax` / `@llvm.maxnum` | Broadcasts scalar with vector |
| `%clamp(x, lo, hi)` | `Int` / `(Int * N)` or `Float` / `(Float * N)` | Same as args | `@llvm.smin`+`smax` / `minnum`+`maxnum` | Bounds `x` to `[lo, hi]` |
| `%abs(x)` | `Int` / `(Int * N)` or `Float` / `(Float * N)` | Same as arg | `@llvm.abs` / `@llvm.fabs` | Magnitude of `x` |
| `%shuffle(v, m)` | `v`: `(T * N)`, `m`: `(Int * M)` literal | `(T * M)` | `shufflevector` | `T` in `Int`, `Float`, `<>`; `m` is compile-time lane mask |
| `%shuffle(a, b, m)` | `a, b`: `(T * N)`, `m`: `(Int * M)` literal | `(T * M)` | `shufflevector` | Two-source lane permutation (`0..2*N-1`) |

## Horizontal vector reductions

| Intrinsic | Argument Types | Return Type | LLVM Lowering | Semantics |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `%all(v)` | `(<> * N)` | `<>` | `@llvm.vector.reduce.and` | `<+>` iff all `N` flag lanes are `<+>` |
| `%any(v)` | `(<> * N)` | `<>` | `@llvm.vector.reduce.or` | `<+>` iff at least one flag lane is `<+>` |
| `%sum(v)` | `(Int * N)` or `(Float * N)` | `Int` or `Float` | `@llvm.vector.reduce.add` / `fadd` | Horizontal lane sum |
| `%prod(v)` | `(Int * N)` or `(Float * N)` | `Int` or `Float` | `@llvm.vector.reduce.mul` / `fmul` | Horizontal lane product |
| `%dot(a, b)` | Matching `(Int * N)` or `(Float * N)` | `Int` or `Float` | Lane mul + horizontal add | Euclidean dot product $\sum a_i b_i$ |

## Floating-point math

All floating-point intrinsics require `Float` (`f64`), `f32`, or homogeneous SIMD tuples `(Float * N)` / `(f32 * N)`. Integer arguments require explicit `Float(n)` conversion.

| Intrinsic | Argument Types | Return Type | LLVM Lowering |
|---|---|---|---|
| `%sqrt(x)` | `Float` / `(Float * N)` | Same as arg | `@llvm.sqrt` |
| `%fma(a, b, c)` | `Float` / `(Float * N)` | Same as args | `@llvm.fma` (fused $a \cdot b + c$, single rounding) |
| `%fmuladd(a, b, c)` | `Float` / `(Float * N)` | Same as args | `@llvm.fmuladd` |
| `%floor(x)` | `Float` / `(Float * N)` | Same as arg | `@llvm.floor` |
| `%ceil(x)` | `Float` / `(Float * N)` | Same as arg | `@llvm.ceil` |
| `%trunc(x)` | `Float` / `(Float * N)` | Same as arg | `@llvm.trunc` |
| `%round(x)` | `Float` / `(Float * N)` | Same as arg | `@llvm.round` |
| `%copysign(m, s)` | `Float` / `(Float * N)` | Same as args | `@llvm.copysign` |
| `%sin(x)` | `Float` / `(Float * N)` | Same as arg | `@llvm.sin` |
| `%cos(x)` | `Float` / `(Float * N)` | Same as arg | `@llvm.cos` |
| `%exp2(x)` | `Float` / `(Float * N)` | Same as arg | `@llvm.exp2` |
| `%log2(x)` | `Float` / `(Float * N)` | Same as arg | `@llvm.log2` |
| `%pow(x, y)` | `Float` / `(Float * N)` | Same as args | `@llvm.pow` |

## Bit manipulation, saturating arithmetic, and bitcasting

| Intrinsic | Argument Types | Return Type | LLVM Lowering | Semantics |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `%popcount(x)` | `Int` / `(Int * N)` | Same as arg | `@llvm.ctpop` | Count set `1` bits |
| `%clz(x)` | `Int` / `(Int * N)` | Same as arg | `@llvm.ctlz` | Count leading zeros |
| `%ctz(x)` | `Int` / `(Int * N)` | Same as arg | `@llvm.cttz` | Count trailing zeros |
| `%bswap(x)` | `Int` / `(Int * N)` | Same as arg | `@llvm.bswap` | Reverse byte order (endian swap) |
| `%bitreverse(x)` | `Int` / `(Int * N)` | Same as arg | `@llvm.bitreverse` | Reverse bit order |
| `%rotl(x, n)` | `Int` / `(Int * N)` | Same as `x` | `@llvm.fshl` | Funnel rotate left by `n` bits |
| `%rotr(x, n)` | `Int` / `(Int * N)` | Same as `x` | `@llvm.fshr` | Funnel rotate right by `n` bits |
| `%uadd_sat(a, b)` | `Int` / `(Int * N)` | Same as args | `@llvm.uadd.sat` | Unsigned saturating addition |
| `%usub_sat(a, b)` | `Int` / `(Int * N)` | Same as args | `@llvm.usub.sat` | Unsigned saturating subtraction (clamps at `0`) |
| `%bitcast(T, x)` | `T`: target type, `x`: equal-width scalar/tuple | `T` | `bitcast` | Reinterprets raw bits without numeric conversion (`E3084` on width mismatch) |

## Memory primitives and scalar formatting

| Intrinsic | Argument Types | Return Type | LLVM Lowering | Semantics |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `%memcpy(dst, src, n)` | `dst: Addr`, `src: Addr`, `n: Int` | `Addr` (`dst`) | `@llvm.memcpy` | Copies `n` bytes between non-overlapping regions |
| `%memmove(dst, src, n)` | `dst: Addr`, `src: Addr`, `n: Int` | `Addr` (`dst`) | `@llvm.memmove` | Copies `n` bytes (overlapping regions safe) |
| `%memset(dst, val, n)` | `dst: Addr`, `val: Int`, `n: Int` | `Addr` (`dst`) | `@llvm.memset` | Fills `n` bytes at `dst` with `u8(val)` |
| `%ptrmask(ptr, mask)` | `ptr: Addr`, `mask: Int` | `Addr` | `@llvm.ptrmask` | Masks pointer bits while preserving LLVM pointer provenance |
| `%to_str(x)` | `Int`, `i8`..`u64`, `Float`, `f32`, `Rune`, `String` | `String` | Runtime arena format | Formats scalar into arena `String` (`E3105` on composites); backs `"${expr}"` |
